feature: Team Management and Invitations - the real artifacts/portal '/team' page (src/pages/customer-team.tsx), part of #1656 (page itself #3996; Billing/Customer-Admin role surface #4013). Adapted from Design/portal/design_handoff_billing_roles_and_new_modules/screens/Team Management.dc.html using this codebase's own React/Vite/Tailwind/shadcn/lucide patterns, wired against all 13 real routes on artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-team.ts via useTeamLive.ts/teamWire.ts: GET /portal/team (roster), POST /portal/team/invite, PATCH /portal/team/:userId/status, DELETE /portal/team/:userId/sessions, PATCH /portal/team/:userId/mfa-enforcement, POST /portal/team/:userId/unlock, POST /portal/team/:userId/reset-password, POST /portal/team/:userId/temp-password, POST /portal/team/:userId/reset-mfa, POST /portal/team/:userId/emergency-bypass, PATCH /portal/team/:userId/manager, and PATCH /portal/team/:userId/role (#3647, wired #4013). The page's ROLES block now draws role chips, held/not-held role cards, grant/revoke confirm modals, and the self-revoke refusal for Customer Admin - see test-manifests/portal/team-role-assignment.json for that route's own auth/validation coverage.
notes: GET /api/portal/team's managerUserId field is new this build (Git #3996) - previously selected only inside the manager-assignment route itself (#2527), never projected on the roster read (contract pack #2895 §5 finding). Added so the page's 'Reports to' panel has something real to read instead of a second, unbuilt lookup.

WHAT THIS COVERS: the roster read's real auth-gate (403 for a caller with no customerId claim is the route's own contract, not asserted here without a non-customer test account; 200 with a real array for an authenticated customer account, including the managerUserId/isCustomerAdmin/hasBillingRole fields this build reads/added), and a real UI walk proving the roster the ENDPOINT returned is the same roster rendered in the DOM (real member row, keyed by the real userId field the endpoint returns).

AUTH CORE HAS LANDED (#2991, Feature #1648) - login.tsx now ships real #email/#password inputs and a login-submit testid, so this manifest drives a real login and asserts the real rendered roster instead of only the pre-auth honest empty state (Git #4104 - this note previously said no login page existed yet; that premise was stale, the same correction test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json already made). The mutating actions (invite, suspend, sessions revoke, MFA enforcement/reset, unlock, password reset/temp-password, emergency bypass, manager assignment, role grant/revoke) remain exhaustively covered by portal-team.test.ts's own vitest suite (14 tests) against the auth/capability gate and business logic directly - this manifest does not re-drive them against a live account whose customer:team.manage grant state isn't established for any test-manifests/portal/*.json account today (the same reasoning team-role-assignment.json's own notes give for not asserting a live 200 grant).
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD.
